feeds.title: Online Journalism Blog
feeds.description: The Online Journalism Blog publishes comments, analyses, and links covering online journalism and online news, data journalism, citizen journalism, blogging, vlogging, photo blogging, podcasts, vodcasts, interactive storytelling, publishing, Computer-Assisted Reporting, User Generated Content, searching, and all things internet.

feeds.title: Journalism.co.uk
feeds.description: Journalism.co.uk reports on news and innovations in digital journalism, including the latest tools, apps and tips for journalists.

feeds.title: Press Gazette
feeds.description: Press Gazette has been reporting on British journalism without fear or favour since 1965. Our mission is to provide journalism news and information service which helps the UK journalism.

feeds.title: HoldtheFrontPage Blog
feeds.description: HoldtheFrontPage is a news and jobs website for journalists everywhere with a particular focus on the UK regional press. This blog is designed to encourage debate on all aspects of the law as it affects working journalists.

feeds.title: LSE Polis Blog
feeds.description: Polis is a think tank at LSE's Department of Media and Communications. It is aimed at working journalists, people in public life and students in the UK and around the world. Polis is the place where journalists and the wider world can examine and discuss the media and its impact on society.

feeds.title: School of Journalism
feeds.description: The School of Journalism, is a unique collaboration between News Associates award-winning journalism training and Marjon University.

feeds.title: Jon Slattery
feeds.description: A freelance journalist writing from the UK. Here he collects and shares his thought-provoking articles from around the web, and focuses on where the boundaries of journalism in the digital age are.

feeds.title: Jomec Blog
feeds.description: Cardiff University School of Journalism, Media and Culture - a world-leading centre for journalism, media and communications teaching and research. Here you will find expert opinion and commentary about research and topical news events.

feeds.title: NLA Blog
feeds.description: NLA licences contribute to a vibrant UK media and support jobs in journalism. Keep up with latest news, updates and opinion from NLA media access.

feeds.title: Centre for Journalism at the University of Kent blogs
feeds.description: The Centre for Journalism at the University of Kent in Medway is dedicated to excellence in journalism. Our students learn through real life experience what it takes to be a working journalist. We are fully accredited by the National Council for the Training of Journalists and strive to be at the forefront of multimedia journalism and digital innovation. Here you will find interesting videos, helpful tutorials and insights into what the NCTJ calls the best journalism BA in the country.
